findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.comment: The signed employee health reporting agreement forms for the person-in-charge (PIC) and an employee were not available during the inspection. The inspector provided blank copies for the PIC and employee to complete and sign. Ensure all employees sign and maintain employee health reporting agreement forms on-site.
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A). [PF]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink was observed to be obstructed with lots of ice cubes in it. CORRECTED: The inspector discussed using the handwashing sink for handwashing purpose only. The ice was melted off with hot water and the sink was accessible for handwashing. Ensure the handwashing sink is not used for purposes other than handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [PF]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment:
The following areas were observed to not have handwashing signs for employees:

1. The male and female restrooms. 
2. The handwashing sink at the bar. CORRECTED: The sign was posted near the handwashing sink during the inspection.

The inspector provided handwashing signs for the two restrooms and the handwashing sink. Ensure the handwashing signs are posted in the restrooms and handwashing sink to notify employees to wash their hands.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.14 Handwashing Signage. A sign or poster that notifies FOOD EMPLOYEES to wash their hands shall be provided at all HANDWASHING SINKS used by FOOD EMPLOYEES and shall be clearly visible to FOOD EMPLOYEES. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
The following food-contact surfaces were observed to be in need of cleaning:

1. The inner wall surface of the ice machine was observed to have soil accumulation.
2. The soda guns and soda holsters were observed to have soil accumulation. One of the soda gun and soda holster was observed to have dead bugs in them. The PIC was instructed to clean them by the inspector during the inspection. The PIC cleaned the soda guns and holsters during the inspection, but they were not cleaned to sight and touch, bugs and soil were still observed in them.

Ensure the ice machine, soda guns and soda holsters are cleaned to sight and touch by washing, rinsing and sanitizing them. The inspector will follow-up on March 23, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [PF]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment:
The following time/temperature for safety (TCS) foods labeled “Refrigerate After Opening” were observed on the counter at the bar:

1. Blue cheese stuffed greek olives.
2. Deli-sliced hot jalapeño peppers.
3. Maraschino cherries.
4. Caramel flavored topping.

The PIC was informed as well as educated by the inspector and the TCS foods were voluntarily discarded. Ensure foods labeled “Refrigerate After Opening” are kept in the cooler and maintained at 5°C (41°F) or less.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. [P]

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: A wet ice scoop was observed to be placed on an absorbent cloth material on the counter by the ice machine. The inspector discussed storing the ice scoop in a non-absorbent container after usage. Ensure the ice scoop is stored in a dry container and not on an absorbent material.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor. [C]

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-303.11: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of FOOD such as melons or FISH, PACKAGED FOODS such as canned BEVERAGES, or cooling coils and tubes of EQUIPMENT, ice may not be used as FOOD. 

A bottle of bourbon is observed stored in the ice bin on the western side of the bar(in contact with the ice). Ice in this container is used for consumer drinks. The bottle was removed and the ice will be discarded prior to opening this afternoon.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

The ceiling over the bar is stomped/popcorn texture. Seal so surface is smooth and easily cleanable. Discussed options to be creative and seal wood over the bar area or plain metal roof.
